mechanism.ordinary_FFmpeg: DVDVideoCodecFFmpeg::Open uses avcodec_find_decoder(H264); actual bundled library returns h264. V4L2 wrapper is a different codec name, not one of that decoder hardware configs.
mechanism.DRM_PRIME_entry: Wayland GLES registers DVDVideoCodecDRMPRIME; corrected private settings enable useprimedecoder and useprimedecoderforhw, disable VAAPI. Registration/setting alone does not establish hardware decoding.
mechanism.DRM_PRIME_filter: FindDecoder loops H264 codecs; FindHWConfig requires AV_PIX_FMT_DRM_PRIME and HW_DEVICE_CTX or INTERNAL. Bundled h264_v4l2m2m has zero returned hardware configs; no candidate matches. Fallback selects native CPU h264.
mechanism.actual_confirmation: avcodec_open2 uprobes record h264 and no h264_v4l2m2m; open/openat/openat2 tracepoints record no CrystalHD node opens during file decode. fd samples independently see neither decode node.
mechanism.driver_boundary: Selection happens before any query/decode of our V4L2 node. Driver QUERYCAP/G_FMT/EXPBUF changes cannot supply missing userspace AVCodec hardware config or change Kodi avcodec_find_decoder calls. No driver fix is justified by this pre-open failure.
mechanism.scope_limit: Current deployed library/build pair, not a claim that every Kodi/FFmpeg build lacks V4L2 support.

trace_scope: Actual kodi.bin PID/tgid, probes attached before ordinary file invocation through close; codec avcodec_open2 plus kernel sys_enter_open/openat/openat2 filtered to actual CrystalHD decode node paths. Other h264 opens include demux probing; they are not picture counts.
